claims.reasoning: Loveland's on bye and I'm not carrying a dead IR body like Michael Wilson while my TE spot sits empty - Freiermuth walks into a juicy spot against Cincinnati and I don't care that I've got zero dollars to put behind it, I'm taking him anyway. Money's not the point. The move is.

trade_offer.message: Selina, I'm doing you a favor here - Derrick Henry's a real name and Cam Ward's got a real arm, both better than what Gary's currently trotting out there, for one quarterback you're not even maximizing. Take the deal before Gary talks you out of the good part of it.

forum_post: Seven and two. Burrow's throwing 40 a week, Chase and Watson both went for 26-plus on the SAME Sunday, and I'm still the only name in this paper that matters. Dumbledore - heard the rumor mill's got you whispering to me AND Patricia on the same day for the same player. Cute. Come talk to the loud guy first or don't talk at all. Selina - sent Gary a trade that makes your team better and he's gonna talk you out of it by Tuesday, book it, that's the real storyline this week, not my bye-week kicker. Golden Child stays retained. Everybody else is just playing for second.
